notes: All 35 source morphemes and all 47 target tokens are partitioned exactly once.

The frame's *that* here stands at the head of the apodosis, after the temporal `כְּ` clause, so rule 45 gives it to the apodosis waw and `הָיָה` keeps only *it came to pass* — the opposite division from 1SA.5.9, which is what that rule's word-order test decides.
Both `עֶקְרוֹן` accusatives are bare directional nominals taking a supplied *to* under rule 33; the two `הָאֱלֹהִים` chains are rule 29's fronting case, the rectum being rendered anarthrously.
The 1cs suffixes of `אֵלַי` and `הֲמִיתֵנִי` are aligned to the plural pronouns the ASV writes, per rule 18's direction to align the pronoun that is written rather than to require number agreement.
The `לְ` of `לֵאמֹר` is `unrepresented` and the infinitive takes *saying* (rule 27).
